assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I25.10 is assigned for atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnosis code I34.0 is assigned for nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to evaluate for potential arrhythmias contributing to hemodynamic instability
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to correlate clinical events with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The CPT code 93247 represents long-term continuous ECG monitoring
The CPT code 93247 is a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study

The CPT 93247 service is directly supported by the documented clinical indication of recurrent dizziness in the setting of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The denial code PR-204 applies to CPT 93247
The denial code PR-204 indicates the requested service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
